steps.operation_intent: Verify live Concat version and deterministic headless mode
steps.precondition: MCP stdio handshake initialized and tools/list captured

steps.operation_intent: Save, close, reopen project and verify semantic timeline fingerprint
steps.expected_postcondition: Reopened timeline_read semantically matches pre-save timeline
